title: Budget versus actual by department and vendor with variance drivers
prompt: Compare actual expenses to budget by department and vendor. Identify the drivers of significant variances and distinguish timing from ongoing cost changes.

setup.q: Which budget version is the comparison against (name or year, and whether reforecasts replace it)?
Above what variance (amount) does a line need a driver?

inputs.name: Budget by department and budget versus actual
Expense transactions by department and vendor

steps: pull the budget named by budgetVersion from Dime, else read the standing budget workbook; pull the month's expenses by department and vendor
compute the variance per department and vendor; every variance above varianceThreshold gets a driver from the transaction detail
label each driver timing (an invoice early or late, an accrual, a prepayment) or ongoing (a rate change, a new vendor, headcount)
run xlsx_update_in_place to write the month's actuals and variances into the standing budget workbook's actuals columns without touching its formulas

done.text: Total actual expense for the month equals the operating expense total on Dime's profit and loss for the period
Every exception row cites the department, the vendor id and the transaction ids behind the driver
budget-vs-actual.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every variance above the threshold is labelled timing or ongoing with the evidence; the budget version used is stated; the budget workbook keeps its formulas
